title: Meet the Frequency: QFR Introduces Its Founding Roster
subtitle: Roster Announcement
excerpt: Sixteen artists. Sixteen different frequencies. One independent label built to give every one of them room to grow.
body: Quantum Frequency Records officially welcomes its founding roster: Buckshot Bourbon, Sawyer Kennedy, Fractal Hearts, Grassroots Rebellion, Warpnotix, Sound Shamans, Immovable Giants, The Jones Beach Boys, The Cosmic Run, Moonflower Radio, Find/Replace, Immortal Prophets, Firewall Nation, Justified Heroes, Cinder Block Statues and Easton Echo. From Long Island country-rock and Nashville country to progressive space rock, punk, electronic music, psychedelic rock, industrial, nu-metal, rap-rock and synth-pop, the roster was never designed to fit neatly inside a genre chart. Each artist brings a different sound, story and creative world to QFR. This is where their stories begin.
